title: arXiv Mathematics — notable papers from the latest daily batch, 8 October 2026
global_caveat: arXiv has no official trending chart. This is an inferred notable-paper selection, not measured popularity; no timely citation or independent attention measure could be verified for this latest batch.

sections.title: The Multiple Unicast Conjecture is False
sections.abstract: The authors construct an undirected network where a deterministic linear code over F₉ beats every fractional multicommodity flow, refuting the multiple-unicast conjecture.
sections.claimed_result: A 182-vertex graph supports 157 unicast sessions at common coding rate at least 1, versus a fractional-flow upper bound of 147/157; amplification gives an Ω((log n)^ε) gap for some ε>0.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Undirected multiple-unicast network coding, deterministic linear code over F₉, compared with fractional multicommodity flow.
sections.unique_caveat: Unrefereed v1. Authors disclose GPT-6 helped find the nondeterministic counterexample; independent checking of the construction and verifier remains important.

sections.title: The Exact Overlaps Conjecture for Self-Similar Measures on the Real Line
sections.abstract: For finitely supported systems of contracting similarities on the real line, the authors prove the dimension formula for the associated self-similar measure in terms of random-walk entropy and the Lyapunov exponent.
sections.claimed_result: The authors prove dim ν = min{1, hμ/|χμ|} for self-similar measures generated by finitely many contracting similarities of ℝ, and derive the expected Hausdorff-dimension formula for the attractor when there are no exact overlaps.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: A probability measure supported on finitely many contracting similarities of ℝ; one-dimensional setting with random-walk entropy hμ and Lyapunov exponent χμ.
sections.unique_caveat: The introduction notes an independent proof was posted in another paper on 6 October; compare proofs and scopes. This preprint's proof has not been independently verified here.

sections.title: Mixing Times of Switch Chains via High-Dimensional Expansion
sections.abstract: The paper uses high-dimensional expansion to bound mixing time of the switch chain sampling labelled graphs with a prescribed degree sequence.
sections.claimed_result: For m edges and maximum prescribed degree Δ, the classical and simplicial switch chains mix in O(Δ²m log m) steps whenever m ≥ CΔ⁸; fixed Δ gives O(n log n) on n-vertex sequences.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Uniform sampling over labelled realizations of a graphical degree sequence, subject to m ≥ CΔ⁸ for an absolute constant C.
sections.unique_caveat: The guarantee requires a strong m-to-Δ condition and does not cover parameter ranges outside that hypothesis.

sections.title: Abundance for threefolds in positive characteristic
sections.abstract: The authors claim the abundance conjecture for projective log-canonical threefold pairs over perfect fields of characteristic greater than 42.
sections.claimed_result: For a projective lc threefold pair over a perfect field of characteristic p>42, nefness of KX+B implies KX+B is semi-ample.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Dimension three; projective lc pair over a perfect field; characteristic p>42; KX+B nef.
sections.unique_caveat: Authors label v1 very preliminary, say they will continue revising it, and rely on bounds in a companion paper not yet published; the result only claims p>42.

sections.title: Sharp Hilbert transform norms on Schatten classes: classification and optimal spectral corrections
sections.abstract: The author gives sharp norm formulas for Hilbert transforms on Schatten-valued Lp spaces and related Schur multipliers, reporting resolutions of several conjectures.
sections.claimed_result: For 1<p<∞, the paper claims norm Cp = cot(π/(2p*)) for the Hilbert transform on Lp(ℝ; Sp) and the ordered Hilbert Schur multiplier on Sp, with p*=max{p,p/(p−1)}.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Schatten-p-valued functions and the stated ordered Schur multiplier, for 1<p<∞; norms and normalization follow the preprint.
sections.unique_caveat: New preprint; operator definitions, normalization, and proofs need specialist review before treating the sharp identities as settled.

sections.title: The circle packing and Riemann uniformization embedding of the tree-weighted planar maps converges to Liouville quantum gravity
sections.abstract: The authors prove scaling limits for spanning-tree-weighted planar maps under circle-packing and Riemann-uniformization embeddings, with related path convergence to SLE₈.
sections.claimed_result: As the number of faces grows, embedded tree-weighted planar maps converge to √2-LQG disk, sphere, or cone; the natural path on faces converges to SLE₈.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Spanning-tree-weighted planar maps in the stated disk, sphere, and whole-plane topologies, under circle-packing or Riemann-uniformization embeddings.
sections.unique_caveat: Proof builds on earlier circle-packing and random-map results and a companion comparison paper; scope is this tree-weighted model, not arbitrary planar maps.

sections.title: A proof of the fractional Lane--Emden conjecture
sections.abstract: The authors prove a Liouville nonexistence result for positive entire solutions of a fractional Lane–Emden system in the strict subcritical range.
sections.claimed_result: For n≥2, 0<s<1, p,q>0, the system (−Δ)^s u=v^p, (−Δ)^s v=u^q has no strictly positive entire solution when 1/(p+1)+1/(q+1)>(n−2s)/n.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Positive entire solutions on ℝⁿ, n≥2, fractional order 0<s<1, and positive exponents p,q satisfying the strict inequality.
sections.unique_caveat: The theorem is limited to the strict inequality; the abstract makes no claim at the critical boundary or in the complementary range.

sections.title: The replica symmetric solution for hypergraph independent sets in the critical regime
sections.abstract: The authors derive a variational formula for independent-set probabilities in locally sparse hypergraphs throughout a critical regime, connecting probabilistic combinatorics with the Bethe free-energy formula.
sections.claimed_result: For binomial random subsets of vertices of a locally sparse hypergraph, the paper gives logarithmic asymptotics for the probability that the subset is independent; the graph clique-avoidance case yields a graphon variational description.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: A broad class of locally sparse hypergraphs in the stated critical regime; the clique-avoidance and graphon conclusion is a specialized case.
sections.unique_caveat: The formula's scope depends on the paper's local-sparsity hypotheses and is not a universal formula for arbitrary hypergraphs.

sections.title: Strict correlation-dimension drop for quartic Salem Bernoulli convolutions
sections.abstract: The authors prove that equal-weight Bernoulli convolutions associated with quartic Salem numbers in (1,2) have correlation dimension strictly below one.
sections.claimed_result: For each quartic Salem β∈(1,2), the equal-weight Bernoulli convolution has correlation dimension below one and therefore no L² density; a separate computer-assisted argument reports near-one numerical bounds for the two such numbers.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Equal-weight Bernoulli convolutions associated with quartic Salem numbers in (1,2); the quantitative estimates concern the two specific numbers.
sections.unique_caveat: Main theorem is qualitative; quantitative estimates use separate computer-assisted arguments and do not cover arbitrary Salem degree or Bernoulli convolutions.
